champion.tips: JAX TIPS AND TRICKS Don’t be trigger happy with your . Only use it when the enemy is a real threat to you as it does have a long cooldown, and you’re quite vulnerable while it’s down. Take objectives like the Rift Herald or Dragon when it’s safe to do so. Jax can take them quite easily, so make sure you get them whenever you can. Try and approach lanes from behind the enemy so you do not have to use your gap closure to get on to them.
champion.builds: THE BEST JAX BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Jax Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Lethal Tempo as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Cosmic Insight and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Trinity Force as your first item, followed by Mercury's Treads and Sundered Sky. For your last 3 items, you should build Zhonya's Hourglass, Sterak's Gage and finish with Wit's End. For the skill order, you want to stick with W - E - Q. Right now, this build has 54.3% winrate over 19 471 matches played. Optional Your second option for Jax Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Trinity Force, which you should build first, followed by Mercury's Treads as your second item and Sundered Sky as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Zhonya's Hourglass, Sterak's Gage and Death's Dance. The skill order for this build is W - E - Q. In the current patch, this build has a 53.8% win rate over 4 413 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Press the Attack as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Trinity Force as your first item, then Mercury's Treads as a second item and Sundered Sky as a third item. You want to finish the build with Zhonya's Hourglass, Sterak's Gage and Wit's End. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it W - E - Q. This build is currently sitting at a 53.6% win rate across 837 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Jax Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Lethal Tempo, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then finish Mercury's Treads as your second item, and Trinity Force as third item. The last 3 options are Sundered Sky, Zhonya's Hourglass and Wit's End. The ability order for this build is W - E - Q. As of the current patch, this build has a 52.0% win rate over 750 matches played. Situational Jax Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Jax build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Jax runes page.
